needs.proposedSignature: AmountCount += 'counters-on-that-any' | 'counters-on-that'  (with `counter?` for the named form), and Condition: { kind: 'that-had-counters'; counter?: string }
needs.semantics: 'Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, IF IT HAD COUNTERS ON IT, create X ... tokens, where X is the number of counters IT had on it.' Both the intervening condition and the amount are about the bound dying creature; the existing `counters-on-source-any` and `self-had-counters` read the SOURCE, so the parser mis-binds them to Felisa herself. Last-known-information (the binding frame already snapshots values on zone change) makes this a small addition.

needs.semantics: 'Whenever this creature attacks, put a +1/+1 counter on target attacking creature with lesser power.' Everything but the target filter exists. Filter carries only absolute power comparisons; the relative form lives nowhere but combat-restr's `power: 'ge-source'` static, which is not a Filter field and cannot reach a TargetSpec. One Filter flag finishes mentor and every 'with lesser/greater power than' target in the pool.
